messages:
ali_sales: Prospect (MetroTrust) wants an on‑prem, air‑gapped POC. Key asks: packaging size, upgrade cadence, telemetry off, and POC billing model.

teresa_se: Short answers: we have slim (runtime-only) and full (operator+models). Air‑gap delivery = signed tar + SBOM + sha256 manifest. Telemetry can be disabled.

nate_engineer: Install flow for offline: copy OCI/tar to jumpbox, run `install-offline.sh --token <jwt>`. Disk reqs: /opt/redwood >= 60GB for full bundle. Hotfix timelines: runtime patch ~20min, operator changes ~1h. Rollback requires pre-made snapshots.

lina_sec: Security Qs: support customer KMS/HSM for key wrap, customer-provided signing keys OK, CycloneDX SBOM, offline cert rotation script. FIPS builds available (separate bundle, +120MB).

ali_sales: Billing: offer 30d trial then either flat POC license or convert to reserved commit. Air‑gap has one-time packaging/signing fee plus optional on‑call support seat for expedited SLA.

teresa_se: Recommended cadence: quarterly bundles by default; monthly security deltas available for an ops surcharge. For a 48h hotfix SLA we need the support seat.

ops_bot: Reminder: POC kickoff w/ MetroTrust 2026-04-05 14:00 UTC.

ali_sales: Action items: @teresa_se draft SOW + fees, @nate_engineer produce minimal install checklist and rollback playbook, @lina_sec prepare short appendix for security questionnaire. I'll share SOW with the prospect after draft.
